documented_probe: C-96b1223d (decode a proprietary binary 3d model format into structured json): reference floor is hard but the covering task exercises it at medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases. Documented probe waiver.
notes: Binary archive-volume parser tuned into a reusable tool. dependent_stages=2: header decode -> 32-byte record-table walk -> payload bounds checks -> CRC-32 validation -> UTF-8 decode -> SHA-256 evidence hashing is a real multi-step chain. reasoning_depth=2: the exact little-endian fixed-layout and the multiple independent validity gates (magic, status, length cap 4096, in-page and in-file bounds, CRC, UTF-8) must all be implemented precisely or hidden cases diverge. adversarial_inputs=2: hidden volumes include wrong magic, too-short files, out-of-bounds and >4096 payloads, bad CRCs, empty and all-tombstone tables, and zero/garbage slots. hidden_case_generalization=2: the program must run cleanly on 5 unseen volumes with different records and numbers. quantitative_correctness=2: exact JSON records and exact SHA-256 evidence hashes are compared byte-for-byte. Debugging ambiguity is mild (1) because endianness and CRC conventions can be misread, and the format is fully documented so nothing needs live exploration beyond stdlib. Medium bucket (total 11).
